SpotiKit 0.9.2 adds proper credit for the code SpotiKit's JavaScript API is based on.

## Credits

- Parts of SpotiKit's JavaScript API are based on [Spicetify](https://github.com/spicetify/cli) and stay under its license, the LGPL-2.1. [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](https://github.com/NMWplays/SpotiKit/blob/main/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) lists them, and those places are marked in the source.
- Every release now comes with `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` and the full LGPL-2.1 text.

Nothing else changed since 0.9.1. SpotiKit updates itself, so you don't have to do anything.
